name: Metronome Pivot Citadel
core_rationale: Central chronometer-guild town of West Pendulum Steppe at [1, 1] built inside the jewel-bearing pivot housing where Krono's Great Pendulum swings.

terrain_tile.water_feature: Ruby-oil lubrication channels circulating around the central pendulum bearing plaza

North.lock_message: The hundred-meter brass pallet-arms of Deadbeat Escapement Bluff slam shut every second; Pendulum-Keeper Horolog requires the Ruby Pallet Pin before unlocking the northern gate.

resident_npcs.name: Pendulum-Keeper Horolog
resident_npcs.dialogue_greeting: Welcome to Metronome Pivot Citadel! Feel that sixty-beat pulse beneath your boots? My 0.60 meter chronometer bench stays level with every swing.

resident_npcs.name: Jewel-Cutter Rubina
resident_npcs.dialogue_greeting: Down in the Counterweight Shaft, a rogue escapement automaton stole the Ruby Pallet Pin. Bring it back to unlock the northern Deadbeat Escapement Bluff!

causal_continuity.evidence: Anchors West Pendulum Steppe at [1, 1] directly above Krono's Counterweight Shaft and connects eastward to Spiral Wormway Ramp.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: Jewel-bearing pivot plaza where ruby lubrication channels glow around the swinging Great Pendulum.

character_scale_consistency.evidence: 0.58 to 0.60m chronometer benches, 0.14m cog-risers, 2.20m x 1.65m doorways, and 13.0m plazas for 1.05m characters.

spatial_and_ecological_consistency.evidence: Safe town hub (0 resident_spawns) at [1, 1] with symmetric West, East, Dungeon, and North (fog_of_lore) portals.

intentional_mystery_discipline.evidence: Guards the northern Deadbeat Escapement Bluff behind a Fog of Lore portal while connecting eastward to Helical-Gear Trench.
